requiredRegressionReview.evidence: test/denque.js explicitly asserts return identity and exact order for default, negative, zero, positive/negative counts larger than size and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
Capacity-5 queue is pushed ten times and asserts head > tail before rotate; verifies order, capacity fields, subsequent overflowing push/unshift, pop/shift/peek/remove and reuse to empty.

Invalid cases preserve object references and state. Empty/singleton reuse is tested. Actual nontrivial rotations use only numbers; object identity is checked only on failed rotations or singleton no-ops.
